prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1001; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording right now, so I'll leave that for the file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. I had a green light going straight.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle came from my right side and went through the red light. It hit the driver's side of my car pretty hard. My airbags went off and I was shaken up.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head?

A: No, I didn't black out. I felt dizzy for a few minutes, but I didn't hit my head on anything.

Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle on your own?

A: Yes, but my lower back started hurting almost right away. It got worse over the next day or so.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider for your back?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and then saw my regular doctor. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do physical therapy.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries or problems with your lower back?

A: I had some stiffness years ago from lifting boxes at work, but nothing that kept me from working. It was fully resolved before this accident.

Q: Are you currently missing work because of the injury?

A: I've missed a few shifts. My doctor has me on light duty for now, and I'm still going to therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm trying to do everything the doctors say so I can get back to normal. Thank you.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
